  <h2 class="dash-section-title"><span class="en">Course progress</span><span class="zh">课程进度</span></h2>

  <div class="about-timeline">

    <div class="about-tl-item done">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-purple"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lesson 1 · Geospatial data models and mapping</span><span class="zh">第 1 讲 · 地理空间数据模型与制图</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip">3 exercises</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">Vector and raster data models, geographic versus projected coordinate
        systems, and thematic mapping principles. Produced the first choropleths of
        Singapore's planning subzones, then went beyond the built-in classification
        methods to percentile and box maps whose breaks come from the data
        distribution itself.</span><span class="zh">矢量与栅格数据模型、地理坐标系与投影坐标系的区别，以及专题制图的原则。先做出新加坡规划分区的首批分级统计图，再越过内置分级方法，改用断点直接取自数据分布本身的百分位图与箱式图。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="about-tl-item done">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-coral"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lesson 2 · Spatial point patterns analysis</span><span class="zh">第 2 讲 · 空间点格局分析</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip chip-blue">2 exercises</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">First-order methods describing where events are dense, and second-order
        methods describing whether events attract or repel one another and at what
        distance. The headline result: Singapore's 1,925 childcare centres are
        strongly clustered, <b>R = 0.552</b>, and the pattern survives every test
        applied to it.</span><span class="zh">一阶方法描述事件在哪里稠密，二阶方法描述事件之间是相互吸引还是排斥、且在什么距离上如此。主要结论是：新加坡 1,925 家托儿中心呈强聚集，<b>R = 0.552</b>，而且这一格局通过了所施加的每一项检验。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="about-tl-item current">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-amber"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lesson 3 · Spatio-temporal point patterns</span><span class="zh">第 3 讲 · 时空点格局</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip chip-amber">1 exercise</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">Adding time to the point pattern: spatio-temporal kernel density
        estimation and space-time K-functions, applied to forest fire detections in
        Kepulauan Bangka Belitung, Indonesia.</span><span class="zh">给点格局加上时间维：时空核密度估计与时空 K 函数，应用于印度尼西亚邦加勿里洞群岛的森林火点探测数据。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="about-tl-item todo">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-grey"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lessons 4 – 5 · Spatial weights and autocorrelation</span><span class="zh">第 4 – 5 讲 · 空间权重与自相关</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip chip-green">4 exercises</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">Four ways of deciding which areas count as neighbours, then the global and
        local statistics built on that decision: Moran&#39;s I and Geary&#39;s C against both
        an analytical and a permutation null, LISA cluster maps, and Getis-Ord Gi*
        hot and cold spots across Hunan&#39;s 88 counties.</span><span class="zh">四种判定「谁是邻居」的方式，以及建立在这一判定之上的全局与局部统计量：Moran&#39;s I 与 Geary&#39;s C 同时对照解析零分布与置换零分布，LISA 聚类图，以及湖南 88 个县上的 Getis-Ord Gi* 热点与冷点。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="about-tl-item done">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-grey"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lesson 6 · Spatially constrained clustering</span><span class="zh">第 6 讲 · 带空间约束的聚类</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip chip-grey">2 exercises</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">Regionalisation with Ward, SKATER and ClustGeo, and the price of requiring
        contiguity measured rather than argued: 26 percentage points of attribute
        homogeneity on the Shan State data. Emerging hot spot analysis over a
        seventeen-year space-time cube.</span><span class="zh">用 Ward、SKATER 与 ClustGeo 做区域化，并把「要求连片」的代价测出来而不是争论出来：在掸邦数据上是 26 个百分点的属性同质性。另有十七年时空立方体上的新兴热点分析。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="about-tl-item done">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-indigo"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lesson 7 · Modelling geographical accessibility</span><span class="zh">第 7 讲 · 地理可达性建模</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip chip-indigo">2 exercises</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">Hansen, KD2SFCA and SAM applied to the same 3,125 &times; 120 road-network
        distance matrix. The three rank the island almost identically, at a rank
        correlation between 0.905 and 0.986; what moves the answer is the decay
        exponent and the 5 km catchment, which leaves 41 per cent of the grid at
        exactly zero. The in-class follow-up runs five floating catchment variants on the same matrix and finds 159 hexagons whose distance to all 120 centres is one copied value, among them the cell that tops the 2SFCA map.</span><span class="zh">把 Hansen、KD2SFCA 与 SAM 用在同一个 3,125 &times; 120 的路网距离矩阵上。三者对全岛的排序几乎一致，秩相关在 0.905 到 0.986 之间；真正改变答案的是衰减指数，以及 5 km 的搜寻域——它让 41% 的网格取值恰为零。课堂练习在同一矩阵上跑了五种移动搜寻域变体，并发现有 159 个六边形到全部 120 个中心的距离是同一个被复制的值，2SFCA 地图上的最高点就是其中之一。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="about-tl-item done">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-coral"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lesson 8 · Market area analysis</span><span class="zh">第 8 讲 · 商圈分析</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip chip-coral">1 exercise</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">Huff trade areas for 28 fast-food stores across 617 Taichung villages. With
        every store given the same size, each village's most probable store is simply its
        nearest, and expected customers track actual sales at r = 0.58, rising to 0.66
        under a gentler distance decay.</span><span class="zh">在台中 617 个村里上为 28 家快餐门店划定 Huff 商圈。各店规模设为相同时，每个村里最可能光顾的门店就是离它最近的那家；预期顾客数与实际销售额的相关为 r = 0.58，改用较平缓的距离衰减后升到 0.66。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="about-tl-item todo">
      <div class="about-tl-dot tile-grey"></div>
      <div class="about-tl-body">
        <div class="about-tl-head">
          <h3><span class="en">Lessons 9 – 10</span><span class="zh">第 9 – 10 讲</span></h3>
          <span class="dash-xchip chip-grey">Ahead</span>
        </div>
        <p><span class="en">Geographically weighted explanatory and predictive models.</span><span class="zh">地理加权解释模型与预测模型。</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <h2 class="dash-section-title"><span class="en">How this site is built</span><span class="zh">本站是怎么搭的</span></h2>

      <p><span class="en">Every page is a <code>.qmd</code> document. Code, output and commentary live

      rendered from the code above them.</span><span class="zh">每一页都是一个 <code>.qmd</code> 文档。代码、输出与说明同处一个文件，所以这里展示的任何东西都不是手工粘贴进来的，图都由其上方的代码渲染而成。</span></p>

      <p><span class="en">All analysis runs locally and is frozen with <code>freeze: auto</code>, so a

    </div>
